name: Davor Ivo Stier - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on EU political strategy on Latin America
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for a much closer partnership between the EU and Latin America and the Caribbean. It wants more trade deals, more investment in roads, energy and digital links, and joint work on climate, migration and fighting drug crime. It also urges the EU to push harder for democracy and human rights, and to speak out against the governments of Cuba, Venezuela and Nicaragua. This is an opinion; it does not change any law.

- The EU is urged to sign trade deals with Mercosur, Mexico and Chile, and to invest more through Global Gateway.
- It affects people in both regions: workers, farmers, migrants, and those facing repressive governments.
- Next: EU and Latin American leaders meet at a summit in Colombia in November 2025.
